_note: Raya language_id + voice_id per account and language. There is no API that lists them: each pair is read off an agent that already runs that language (python3 scripts/raya_testcall.py whoami <uuid>), with the source agent and date recorded. IDs differ per account, so re-check after any account change. scripts/raya_testcall.py `lang` reads this file (account 'ekstep' unless the RAYA_ACCOUNT environment variable names another). A language with no pair here cannot be tested yet: ask LitWiz for the pair instead of testing on another language's voice.
